Game Overview

Sky Explorer puts players into a airplane experience centered on quick, browser-based gameplay.

How to Play

The moment-to-moment gameplay in Sky Explorer is easy to pick up. Jump in, follow the on-screen goal, and aim to beat your own best result each run.

Related FAQs

What is Sky Explorer?

Sky Explorer is a free airplane game you can play instantly in your browser, with no download required.

Is Sky Explorer free to play?

Yes, Sky Explorer is completely free to play in your browser on GameBurst — no download or installation needed.
